info.title: Hosty Agent Execution API
info.description: Independent provider execution. Paths are relative to the current Core-declared interface base. Exact UTF-8 command bytes and stable mutation UUIDs are retained across retries. No Harness dependency or raw native session IDs.

get.description: Open a fresh live subscription. The optional previous cursor checks archive ancestry. The ready event returns the subscribed boundary. Subsequent observation events carry an SSE id and every durable record carries its session position.

200.description: Ready boundary followed by live observations.

get.description: At-least-once SSE. after and Last-Event-ID must agree. Persisted Event envelopes use event: agent and an opaque id cursor. 410 replay_expired requires installing a fresh atomic snapshot before following its cursor. Disconnect never cancels execution.

coreOperation.description: Fresh Core exact-operation credential, never the caller's service/user token.

latestContext.description: Latest root context.updated observation within the snapshot watermark; its canonical positive sequence is at most lastSequence. Null usage explicitly clears the observation. Absence means no retained observation. Payloads share the bounded snapshot/event JSON byte allowance.
